prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a seamless, tileable paper texture for a readable web diary page. Primary request: macro photograph of clean natural warm ivory writing paper, filling a square 1024 by 1024 frame edge to edge. Material: exceptionally subtle fine cellulose fibers and natural paper tooth, very low contrast and visually quiet so dark handwritten HTML lettering remains perfectly readable above it. Color: softly warm ivory, close to #f4eedf, almost uniform with only delicate microscopic fiber variation. Lighting: completely even diffuse flat scanner lighting. Constraints: one flat continuous paper surface, no page edges, no folds, no creases, no shadows, no vignette, no stains, no speckles or dirt, no patterns, no lines or ruling, no text, no logos, no objects, no borders. It must read as real paper at normal scale, not as a noisy distressed background. Seamless edges suitable for tiling in both directions.
